title: Taking Away
short: Take some away and count what is left.

blocks.html: When some go away, there are fewer. 4 birds sit in a row. 1 flies away. How many are left? 3!

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: 1 bird flew away. How many are left?

blocks.html: Taking away makes fewer. Count what is left.

For the grown-up: Act it out with snacks: “You have 4 crackers. You eat 1. How many now?” Cover the ones that went away with your hand and count the rest. Keep screen time short: two or three problems, then play.

items: Try it at home: Eat snacks one by one and count what is left.
Hide some blocks under a cup and count the rest.

sources.name: Head Start Early Learning Outcomes Framework (ELOF), Mathematics Development, preschool goals P-MATH 1 to 10
